title: Single-Area OSPFv2 Configuration and Verification
summary: Configure dynamic link-state routing using single-area OSPFv2 in Area 0, configure 32-bit Router IDs, calculate wildcard masks, suppress unnecessary hello broadcasts with passive interfaces, and verify neighbor adjacencies.
learning_objectives: Explain the fundamentals of link-state routing and OSPF Area 0 backbone operation
Configure an explicit 32-bit OSPF Router ID using the router-id command
Activate OSPFv2 on router interfaces using network statements and inverted wildcard masks
Configure passive-interface on client-facing LANs to secure the routing domain
Verify OSPF neighbor adjacency states (FULL/DR, FULL/BDR) using show ip ospf neighbor
Inspect OSPF routes in the routing table (code O) using show ip route ospf

source.origin: Independently authored routing curriculum guide based on IETF RFC 2328 standards and Cisco IOS configuration documentation
